newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 20.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - July 20.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Jordanian court sentenced a Jordanian soldier to life in prison for killing seven Israeli schoolgirls.
- Iran's president said stability in the Gulf depended on Iranian-Arab coordination.
- European Investment Bank loaned Egypt $202 million to finance infrastructure and environmental projects.
- Turkey approved a trade deal and a free zone with Israel.
- Saudi interior minister arrived in Yemen for talks on a border dispute.
- Yemen invested 16.5 billion riyals in the tourism sector and expects 500,000 visitors in the year 2000.
